title: Renewal Loyalty Program Terms: Reduction on Estimated Electricity Charges
content:
# Renewal Loyalty Reduction on Estimated Electricity — Utility Services Program

**Term.** The renewal loyalty reduction on a Utility Services Program estimated electricity line is:

| Renewal rent changes on record for the lease | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 5% (0.05) |
| at least 1 but fewer than 3 | 2% (0.02) |
| none | 0% (0.0) |

It is the Larkspur renewal loyalty program's allowance on a charge the resident could not check against a read. The usage charge of the estimated electricity line is taken at one less the reduction.

**Records read.** Renewal rent changes are the rent changes recorded with the reason renewal on the Lease Term Agreement records of the lease the utility account serves. Rent changes for other reasons are not counted.

## Worked cases (hypothetical usage charge before the reduction of $120.00)

- Four renewals: 5% reduction; the usage charge is taken at 0.95, $114.00.
- Two renewals: 2% reduction; 0.98, $117.60.
- No renewal: no reduction; $120.00.
